input: Question on PF wage ceiling What is the current PF wage ceiling and how should we treat employees above it in the August run? Your article KB-0142 is what we followed so far.
draft: The current PF wage ceiling is INR 25,000 per month, effective from 1 Aug 2026 [R-IN-PF-2026-08, effective 1 Aug 2026]. Employees earning above this amount should have PF contributions applied only on the first INR 25,000 of their wages.

input: PF wage ceiling kitna hai? PF ka wage ceiling abhi kitna hai? Basic 38000 wale employee ka PF kaise calculate hoga? KB KB-0142 follow kiya tha.
draft: PF ka wage ceiling INR 15,000 per month hai [KB-0142]. Basic salary INR 38,000 wale employee ke liye, PF ka calculation INR 15,000 tak ke component (basic + DA) ke upar kiya jata hai, agar joint option nahi liya gaya hai [KB-0142]. Employer ka contribution bhi ceiling ke hisab se hi hoga, jab tak joint option nahi hota [KB-0143].
context: The EPF statutory wage ceiling is INR 15,000 per month. PF is computed at 12% of basic+DA up to the ceiling. Employees drawing more than INR 15,000 may contribute on actual wage only through a joint option.
For employees above INR 15,000 wage, employer contribution is restricted to the ceiling unless the joint option is exercised.
